Come join @dmcguire13
and me for a conversation at the @UrbanConsulate in Detroit, tonight 6-8pm: "As the #MeToo movement grows, who is being left behind?" Read our essay in @BridgeMichigan to make the most of it https://t.co/05GohZZ40G
